thread: Ravi Narayan: Tiny accessibility items from today's console QA: status pills in the model list are purely visual (span) and not keyboard-focusable. Keyboard users can't read the status except by linear SR reading. Maya Patel: Good catch. Are the pills conveying state only, or actions? Ravi Narayan: State only (staging / deployed / degraded). But we rely on color and an icon. Screen readers read the row but don't always read the icon label. Claire O'Neil: For state-only chips we should add aria-describedby linking the chip text to the row, or include the state in the row's accessible name. Eg: or add Status: Deployed. Sasha Lee: Also: if we want the pills focusable (so keyboard users can inspect tooltip details), make them buttons with aria-pressed if toggleable, or role=note for non-interactive. But be consistent. Ravi Narayan: Another one: nested modals + tabs in the deployment details flyout confuse VoiceOver. When you open the flyout (role=dialog) and then open a nested settings modal, NVDA sometimes reports two dialogs. Focus trapping feels flaky. Maya Patel: Nested dialogs are tough. Preferred pattern: avoid true nested modal dialogs. Convert inner modal to an in-dialog panel or slide-over that keeps role=region and uses aria-labelledby. If it must be a dialog, ensure the outer dialog gets aria-hidden and inert when inner dialog opens. Also restore focus correctly. Claire O'Neil: For the tabs inside the flyout, we were missing role=tablist/role=tab semantics. SR users heard content change but not which tab was active. Add proper roles and manage aria-selected + tabindex for roving focus. Sasha Lee: A11Y-bot flagged dynamic status updates (deploy progress) are not announced. We should update a polite live region with "Deploy succeeded" or "Deploy at 74%" but be careful to throttle updates. Use aria-live=polite and only push milestone messages. a11y-bot: Auto-scan: status chips missing accessible text ❌; nested-dialog focus trap risk ⚠️; tab semantics missing within flyout ❌; live region absent for deploy progress ⚠️. Report: https://redwood-internal/a11y/2079994321 Ravi Narayan: Proposed fixes: 1) Add sr-only state text for chips + aria-hidden on decorative icons; 2) Convert inner modal to role=region with aria-labelledby or mark outer dialog inert when inner dialog opens; 3) Implement role=tablist semantics for flyout tabs; 4) Add deploy-live-region with throttled messages at 25% increments and final success/fail message. Maya Patel: Please include a short Playwright keyboard test: open model row, Tab to status pill (or into sr-only), open flyout, Tab into tabs, Arrow keys switch tabs, open settings panel and assert focus trap. Also include NVDA + VoiceOver manual steps for nested dialog behavior. Claire O'Neil: I'll prototype the sr-only tokens and the live region behavior. Also include screenshots of VoiceOver announcement before/after. Sasha Lee: Reminder: when adding live regions, include language (lang="en") and avoid too many updates. Also document the throttling rule in the PR. Ravi Narayan: I'll open the PR with code snippets and tests later today. Tagging @eng-runtime for inert polyfill if needed. Thanks!
